question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

This __narrow__ lane will take you to your destination.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (broad)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"narrow"** means limited in width, especially in comparison to length. (संकीर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **The narrow path was difficult to navigate.
 
 
 
• **"Broad" **refers to having a wide distance from side to side. (चौड़ा)
 
 
• **Example: **We walked along the broad avenue filled with shops and cafes.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'narrow' **is **'broad'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (broad)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mild** (हल्का): Not severe, serious, or harsh.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather was mild and pleasant.
 
 
 
• **Straight** (सीधा): Extending or moving uniformly in one direction only; without a curve or bend.
 
 
• **Example: **The road runs straight for miles.
 
 
 
• **Slender** (पतला): Gracefully thin.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a slender figure.
